title: VersaSlot: Efficient Fine-grained FPGA Sharing with Big.Little Slots and Live Migration in FPGA Cluster
problem: Current FPGA sharing via dynamic partial reconfiguration (DPR) suffers from partial reconfiguration contention and task execution blocking that degrade application performance in shared FPGA environments.
motivation: FPGAs are increasingly deployed for on-demand acceleration in data centers, but fine-grained multiplexing via DPR introduces contention bottlenecks; efficient cluster-level sharing with low blocking is critical.
method: VersaSlot introduces a Big.Little slot heterogeneous architecture where larger slots accommodate longer tasks and smaller slots handle shorter workloads, reducing contention. Includes efficient slot allocation/scheduling and cross-board live migration for cluster-wide multiplexing on Xilinx UltraScale+ FPGAs.
key_novelty: Big.Little heterogeneous slot architecture combining efficient allocation, scheduling, and seamless live migration to resolve DPR contention and task blocking.
contributions: Big.Little heterogeneous slot architecture resolving partial reconfiguration contention and task blocking
Efficient slot allocation and scheduling algorithm optimizing resource utilization
Cross-board live migration enabling FPGA cluster-wide multiplexing achieving 13.66x lower response time vs temporal FPGA multiplexing

metrics.speedup: 13.66x lower response time vs temporal; 2.19x vs SOTA spatio-temporal

limitations: Power consumption and reconfiguration bandwidth not detailed.
primary_theme: Big.Little heterogeneous FPGA sharing with live migration
